audience: Engineers onboarding to the deployment + release process

mode_descriptions.staging: Auto-sync on merge to main; no approval gate; deploys to the staging namespace on the on-prem cluster
mode_descriptions.prod: Manual sync gate; Argo CD syncs the prod namespace; drift detection + self-heal enabled; rollout watched via OTel

flows.name: Deploy (git push → sync)
flows.purpose: Main release flow: merge to main → Dagger CI builds + pushes a signed image → bumps the manifest → Argo CD detects the change and syncs the cluster → rollout completes.
step_outline: repo → ci         : merge to main triggers Dagger pipeline
ci → ci           : lint · test · build (internal stages)
ci → registry     : push signed image tag
ci → repo         : commit new image digest to GitOps manifest
argocd → repo     : poll / webhook detects manifest drift from live
argocd → cluster  : sync · apply Deployment (auto on staging, gated on prod)
cluster → services: rolling update · health checks pass

flows.name: Rollback
flows.purpose: A release went bad. Revert the GitOps manifest to the previous digest; Argo CD syncs the known-good image. No rebuild.
step_outline: repo → repo       : revert manifest commit to previous digest
argocd → repo     : detect the reverted manifest
argocd → registry : resolve the previous (already-pushed) image
argocd → cluster  : sync · redeploy previous revision
cluster → state   : verify schema compatibility (no forward migration)

flows.name: Drift Detect (self-heal)
flows.purpose: Someone kubectl-edited live state out of band. Argo CD sees live ≠ Git and reconciles. Prod self-heals automatically; staging just flags OutOfSync.
step_outline: argocd → cluster  : compare live manifests vs Git (continuous)
argocd → argocd   : mark Application OutOfSync · diff
argocd → cluster  : self-heal sync (prod) · or flag only (staging)
cluster → services: live state reconciled back to Git desired state

flows.name: Promote staging → prod
flows.purpose: Promote the exact staging digest into the prod manifest behind the manual sync gate. Prod-only — staging auto-syncs and has nothing to promote into.

lessons: Git is the single source of truth: CI never kubectl-applies — it commits an image digest to the GitOps manifest, and Argo CD (orch) is the only thing that touches the cluster. That pull-based seam is the whole point of GitOps.
Staging and prod share one pipeline shape and differ only by mode: auto-sync vs a manual gate, self-heal on/off, and cluster size. Same flow, different deployment context — a textbook mode use.
Rollback and drift-detect reuse already-pushed images, so they have no build step — they are pure Argo CD sync flows, which is why they are short.
Promote is prod-only (only_mode='prod') because staging auto-syncs from main and has no gate to promote through.
The registry and Postgres both use the vector role (violet) and are told apart by label, keeping the diagram inside the 6-role cap.
